name: TAPDreamer
summary: Proposes a fixed adversarial patch against world action models, optimised against a public visual encoder without queries to the target policy, and evaluates its transfer in closed loop.
numbers: FastWAM 97.7%→0.0% on 40 LIBERO tasks, 90.86%→0.0% on 50 RoboTwin; random patches leave about 80%

why.cog: Not the target of the attack.
why.xr: Attack through a shared public encoder.
